title: Delete the duplicate readInIsrael/writeInIsrael test group in sacred_time_preferences_test.dart
why: The group at line 191 tests the exact same three scenarios as the group at line 171 (default-false, true-after-write, false-after-write-false) with only the test names changed. It adds no coverage and doubles the maintenance cost of any future change to these methods' behavior.
recommendation: Delete the second (line 191-209) group; it is fully subsumed by the first.
acceptance_criteria: No assertions are lost when the duplicate group is removed
